_notes: Eredin's deck is sheet 176 (CardIDs 17600-17629, the 30 playing cards; the character card is 350 on sheet 3) like Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's and the rest: only deck.identity tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

The Red Riders' pieces are four Custom_Token objects (a954e5 Maxwell, bb3949 Aleksei, 63fb79 Adrian, dc3fc9 Norman, scale 0.45) with no life dial (1 life each); real TTS reports an object imported from a save as a Tile, so nothing that reads or moves them may filter on obj.type (tests/test_eredin_human.py). Eredin's miniature is the Custom_Model dd0bc4 and his life dial the Custom_Model a0a36e (MAX_VALUE 14, the 'Hero Health' script), both nicknamed 'Eredin'.
No GUID is shared with another hero (tests/test_hero_eredin_data.py).
